summary: Validated Conselho IA Diagnostic Report (16 sections). Backend pytest 4/4 PASSED. Frontend: login + sidebar render confirmed; tab/panel selectors exist in code; main agent already smoke-screenshotted diagnostic tab. Networkidle waits time out because dashboard has continuous chart re-renders (recharts) – this is a pre-existing UI quirk, not a regression.

issues: Recharts warnings: width(-1)/height(-1) on containers without explicit min dimensions causes networkidle to never settle – minor noise, unrelated to diagnostic feature

action_items: (opt) Add minWidth/minHeight to recharts ResponsiveContainers to silence warnings and stabilize networkidle for e2e tests.
critical_code_review_comments: diagnostic_report.py is ~1000 lines — borderline acceptable since each section is isolated; consider splitting per-section helpers into a sections/ subpackage if more sections are added.
Endpoint reads list_collection_names + many count_documents sequentially — ~1.2s now; could become slow on larger DBs. Acceptable for diagnostic on-demand use.
No _id leakage detected: all find_one/find queries use projection {"_id": 0} or aggregate without _id.
Frontend DiagnosticReportPanel.js correctly uses api._client (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL based), no hardcoded URLs.
All required data-testids present: cia-tab-conselho, cia-tab-diagnostic, diagnostic-report-panel, diag-section-XX_*, diag-period-select, diag-refresh, diag-error, diag-db-toggle-all.

success_rate.frontend: code-review pass; full e2e blocked by networkidle on dashboard – not feature-related

context_for_next_testing_agent: Diagnostic report endpoint is at /api/conselho-ia/diagnostic-report?days=N. Uses get_current_user. Returns dict with id, company_id, generated_at, period_days, elapsed_ms, sections{01..16}. Each section has {title, data}. Frontend tab nav in ConselhoIaPanel.js via view state. To run e2e against main dashboard, do NOT use wait_for_load_state('networkidle') — use explicit selectors or domcontentloaded; recharts on the Painel re-renders forever.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Backend tests cover: 401 without token, 200 with admin token, 16-section keys exact match, period_days reflection (7), elapsed_ms<10000, shape checks for sections 01/02/04/12/15/16.
